declarations.type:
∀ {candidateUniverse : List SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate}
  {initial finalState : SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopState} {steps : Nat},
  SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopTrace initial finalState steps →
    SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopWellFormed initial →
      SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopCovers candidateUniverse initial →
        SearchRouteInspectLoop.loopWork finalState = 0 →
          SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopClosed finalState ∧
            ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
              candidate ∈ candidateUniverse → SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse finalState.selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectLoop.zero_work_trace_closes_and_is_globally_optimal

declarations.type:
∀ {candidateUniverse : List SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate}
  {initial finalState : SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopState} {steps : Nat},
  SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopTrace initial finalState steps →
    SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopWellFormed initial →
      SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopCovers candidateUniverse initial →
        steps = SearchRouteInspectLoop.loopWork initial →
          SearchRouteInspectLoop.LoopClosed finalState ∧
            ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
              candidate ∈ candidateUniverse → SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse finalState.selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectLoop.full_budget_trace_closes_and_is_globally_optimal

declarations.type:
∀ (selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate) (frontier : SearchRouteInspectScheduler.CertifiedPartialFrontier),
  SearchRouteInspectLoop.NonStrictCreditValid (SearchRouteInspectLoop.stutterWorkFrontier frontier)
      [SearchRouteInspectLoop.stutterWorkFrontier frontier] ∧
    SearchRouteInspectLoop.applyDecision (SearchRouteInspectLoop.stutterState selected frontier)
          (SearchRouteInspectLoop.stutterDecision selected frontier) =
        SearchRouteInspectLoop.stutterState selected frontier ∧
      SearchRouteInspectLoop.loopWork
          (SearchRouteInspectLoop.applyDecision (SearchRouteInspectLoop.stutterState selected frontier)
            (SearchRouteInspectLoop.stutterDecision selected frontier)) =
        SearchRouteInspectLoop.loopWork (SearchRouteInspectLoop.stutterState selected frontier)
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectLoop.non_strict_credit_allows_stutter
